title: Properties of Materials
seo_title: Grade 2 Properties of Materials Worksheets: Hard, Soft, Floats, Sinks
standard_text: Plan and conduct an investigation to describe and classify different kinds of materials by their observable properties.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 science worksheets on properties of materials (NGSS 2-PS1-1): hard and soft, rough and smooth, see-through, floats or sinks, and simple tests. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Look, touch and test: hard or soft, floats or sinks.
body_html:
How to think about it

Every material has properties you can see and feel.

  • Look: color, shiny or dull, see-through.
  • Touch: hard or soft, rough or smooth, bends or not.
  • Test: does it float or sink? Does it soak up water?
Example

Which is see-through: wood, glass or a rock?

You can see through it.

Answer: glass

Example

A sock is soft and bends. What is it made of?

Think about clothes.

Answer: cloth

Common mistakes

  • Thinking heavy things are always hard.
  • Thinking all metal things float. Most metal sinks.
  • Mixing up color words and texture words.

faq.a: Things you can observe, like color, texture, hard or soft, see-through, and whether it floats or soaks up water.
Drop water on them, put them in water, try to bend them, and compare what happens.
They help us choose the best material for a job, like plastic for a raincoat.

c: to choose the right material for a job
